title: Organic pattern on plate planes

request.text: добавь теперь на плоскостях вот такой паттерн, скейлом рисунка хочу управлять

decision: Render a deterministic organic binary pattern only on the four exposed lower plate top faces and expose one continuous scale slider in the base-pattern section.
checks: Focused schema and render-plan unit tests
risks: High-frequency shader detail needs derivative antialiasing; the test must prove scale changes feature frequency without altering side faces.
